title: Portrait of Lila Marks Owen, 1940s Sepia Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1940s snapshot featuring a woman identified on the back as Lila Marks Owen. She is dressed in a tailored dark skirt suit with structured shoulder pads typical of the World War II era, accented with flowers in her hair and on her suit lapel. She sits on a stone balustrade in front of a leafy garden and an ivy-covered stone building.
